# no-simultaneous-deploy

**Claim.** Two things that deploy separately can never change at the same instant, so any change requiring them to is not a plan.

**Not when.** When both sides genuinely deploy as one artefact · When nothing has read the old shape yet · When the window is provably empty

**Check.** both mixes are tested: old reader with new data, new reader with old data

*reasoned.* Open the full note only when you cannot tell whether its boundary holds here: [no-simultaneous-deploy](../notes/active/no-simultaneous-deploy.md).
